examples.title: Library service architecture
examples.source:
flowchart LR
  subgraph product["Library service"]
    subgraph intake["Reader requests"]
      portal["Reader portal"]
      reserve["Reservation API"]
      portal --> reserve
    end
    subgraph stock["Branch inventory"]
      queue["Transfer queue"]
      shelf["Shelf inventory"]
      queue --> shelf
    end
    reserve -->|hold request| queue
    shelf -->|availability| portal
  end
  subgraph delivery["Delivery"]
    schedule["Delivery scheduler"]
    alert["Reader notification"]
    schedule --> alert
  end
  shelf -->|branch transfer| schedule
  schedule -->|confirmed slot| reserve

examples.title: Publishing workflow
examples.source:
flowchart LR
  draft["Draft"] --> read["Editorial review"]
  read --> fact["Fact check"]
  fact --> typeset["Typesetting"]
  typeset --> proofs["Proof approval"]
  proofs --> build["Build edition"]
  build --> publish["Publish"]
  fact --> permissions["Check image rights"]
  permissions --> proofs
  build --> archive["Archive originals"]

examples.title: Observatory services
examples.source:
flowchart LR
  control["Control room"] -->|observe| antenna["Antenna"]
  antenna -->|signal| sampler["Signal sampler"]
  sampler -->|batch| store["Data store"]
  store -->|latest batch| quality["Quality monitor"]
  quality -->|resample| control
  store -->|catalog| archive["Archive"]
  quality -->|status| archive
  control -->|forecast| calendar["Night schedule"]
  calendar -->|window| antenna

examples.title: Workshop controls
examples.source:
flowchart LR
  sensor["Temperature sensor"] -->|reading| panel["Control panel"]
  sensor -->|low battery| panel
  panel -->|retry| panel
  checklist["Opening checklist"] --> lights["Shop lights"]
  clock["Wall clock"]

examples.title: Service mesh
examples.source:
flowchart LR
  subgraph Intake
    A1[Intake gateway]
    A2[Intake queue]
    A3[Intake worker]
    A4[Intake archive]
    A5[Intake monitor]
    A1 --> A2
    A2 --> A3
    A3 --> A4
    A4 --> A5
    A5 --> A1
  end
  subgraph Catalog
    B1[Catalog gateway]
    B2[Catalog queue]
    B3[Catalog worker]
    B4[Catalog archive]
    B5[Catalog monitor]
    B1 --> B2
    B2 --> B3
    B3 --> B4
    B4 --> B5
    B5 --> B1
  end
  subgraph Dispatch
    C1[Dispatch gateway]
    C2[Dispatch queue]
    C3[Dispatch worker]
    C4[Dispatch archive]
    C5[Dispatch monitor]
    C1 --> C2
    C2 --> C3
    C3 --> C4
    C4 --> C5
    C5 --> C1
  end
  subgraph Fulfillment
    D1[Fulfillment gateway]
    D2[Fulfillment queue]
    D3[Fulfillment worker]
    D4[Fulfillment archive]
    D5[Fulfillment monitor]
    D1 --> D2
    D2 --> D3
    D3 --> D4
    D4 --> D5
    D5 --> D1
  end
  A2 -->|lookup| B1
  A3 -->|schedule| C1
  B3 -->|enrich| C2
  B4 -->|store copy| D2
  C3 -->|dispatch| D1
  C4 -->|update cache| B4
  D2 -->|status| B5
  D4 -->|audit| A5
  A5 -->|probe| C5
  D3 -->|heartbeat| C5
  B1 -->|outbound| D5
  C1 -->|receipt| A4
